Experience with perspective

Counsel shaped by experience.

Ibrahim Yassein Alsayed Nowigi is a Senior Legal Advisor and Executive Director with 35 years of legal advisory experience. His work is grounded in careful analysis, commercial awareness and respect for each client's circumstances.

Complex legal and commercial questions rarely have one-size-fits-all answers. The advisory approach is measured and discreet: understand the issue, assess the context, and help clients make informed decisions.

How do I make an enquiry?

Use the enquiry form or email Ibrahimnowigi@Ibrahimnowigi.com. Share a short overview and preferred way to be contacted.

What should I include in my first message?

A brief summary of the issue, relevant dates and your contact details is a helpful start. Please do not attach confidential documents until a secure channel is agreed.
